title: Minutes South of Downtown Nashville
description:
Just 2 miles south of downtown lies my duplex in the Wedgewood Houston neighborhood. It has an urban, industrial, artsy vibe that is one of a kind to Nashville with several art galleries within walking distance of each other as well as several great restaurants and bars. Place includes: 2 queen beds and a queen sized pullout couch, full kitchen with plenty of coffee, and washer and dryer.

The space
Cozy space very close to downtown so you can easily come and go. Entire place was redone November 2017 so you get a very clean and stylish accomadation. 2 bedrooms with a cozy livingroom and full kitchen.

Guest access
Driveway on both sides of the house and front door keycode access.

Other things to note
Driveway on the right is shared with the duplex next door so keep to the left side if using the right driveway.
